title: Rockman
review:
A pretty good port of the original NES game with some nice additional content. It's just too bad the player collision is wonky in this one. Overall, it's a decent way to play Mega Man 1, but if you want an experience closer to the original but with more additional content, get the Legacy Collection instead.

Achievement-wise, it's pretty easy to master and a good way to get used to mastering Mega Man games, since there's no typical no-damage achievement here. So go ahead and give this one a try.
